servicesPage.title: Nineteen services. Five departments. One team.
servicesPage.lede: Every service is a set of named options, not a vague retainer. Pick the shape that fits the stage you are in; we scope it, quote it in writing, and put the same people on it who sold it.
servicesPage.indexNote: Pricing is quoted per scope. No rate card, no surprise line items.

pricingPage.title: No rate card. A real quote.
pricingPage.lede: Every brand needs a different mix of strategy, production, media and build. Tell us the goal and the deadline, and we will send a written scope, a price and a start date within two working days.
pricingPage.bundlesLede: Start from a shape, then tune it. Each plan is quoted after the call, so you pay for the scope you actually need.
pricingPage.factorsLede: Not a menu with multipliers. Four things decide most of the price, and all four go in writing before work starts.

factors.title: Scope
factors.body: How many services, channels and deliverables are in play.

factors.title: Production
factors.body: Shoot days, editing volume and original assets.

factors.title: Pace
factors.body: Launch date, timeline and how much runs at once.
